facts: Order 4417 is **nine days late**, against the delivery date on the order.
The customer asks for a refund of the full amount.
The [late delivery policy](https://help.example.com/policies/late-delivery) covers a delivery more than seven days late.
solution:
## How to do it

Refund the full amount and tell the customer.

## Why this is the best

The late delivery policy covers a delivery this late.

options.title: The shop
options.explanation: The late delivery is the shop's fault.

options.title: The customer
options.explanation: The terms of sale say the customer pays.
